item.title: Watch Taylor Swift Join in on the Raucous Celebration at MSG After the Knicks’ Game 4 Win
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we're diving into the latest news and trends. And today, we've got a story that's got everyone talking: Taylor Swift celebrating the New York Knicks' big win. Let's dive in."
[Cut to music transition]
Host: "The Knicks took on the San Antonio Spurs in game four of the NBA finals, and it was a nail-biter. But in the end, they came out on top, winning 107-106. And Taylor Swift was right there to celebrate with them."
[Cut to sound clip of crowd cheering]
Host: "Swift was sitting courtside at Madison Square Garden with some big names, including Mariska Hargitay and Alana and Este Haim. And when the buzzer sounded, she was one of the first to jump up and cheer. In a clip posted by the NBA, you can see her exiting the arena, spotting the Knicks City Dancers, and immediately starting to dance and cheer."
[Cut to music transition]
Host: "She wasn't the only star in attendance, though. Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, and Kylie Jenner were all there, cheering on the Knicks. And in a sweet moment, Jenner even gave Swift a hug on the court after the game."
[Cut to music transition]
Host: "This isn't the first time Swift has shown her love for the Knicks, either. She caught a game with her fiancé Travis Kelce back in May. And with her busy schedule, it's impressive she was able to make it out to the game. She's got a big week ahead of her, with the Songwriters Hall of Fame ceremony on Thursday, where she'll become the youngest female artist to be inducted."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time."
